title: Fight simulator
subtitle: A premium feature: resolve a hypothetical battle with no army, settlement, or database involved — nothing here touches your real game state.
demoModeHint: The simulator calls the real backend and needs a logged-in premium account — it isn't wired up in demo mode.

premium.title: Premium feature
premium.rejected: The fight simulator is a premium feature. This account isn't premium, so the server turned that last request down.
premium.notPremium: The fight simulator is a premium feature. This account isn't premium.
premium.honestNote: There's no upgrade flow in this game yet — nowhere here actually sells premium — so there's nothing more to click. Ask whoever runs this world if you think that's wrong.

sections.defenderHint: Leave empty to simulate an undefended settlement.
sections.guestDefendersHint: Optional — combined with the defender's own garrison, like a real Support army.

errors.noAttacker: Add at least one attacking unit first.
